title: API readiness failed when Postgres was stopped
summary: Postgres was scaled down to 0 replicas. The API could not connect to the database, so /readyz returned HTTP 503.

signals.evidence: The metric increased after repeated /readyz checks while Postgres had 0 replicas.
The 5xx rate became non-zero during the database outage window.

root_cause: The API readiness check depends on Postgres. When Postgres was unavailable, the API correctly reported not ready.
fix: Scale Postgres back to 1 replica and wait for /readyz to return HTTP 200.
follow_up_actions: Check database pod readiness before debugging the API.
Keep database dependency failures visible on the Grafana dashboard.
